verdict.rationale: A direct probe confirms Kong's developer documentation serves a live llms.txt file at developer.konghq.com/llms.txt with a structured summary of docs across Gateway, Konnect, AI Gateway, and Mesh, which an agent could be pointed at directly. This is independently verified (not just claimed) evidence of agent-oriented documentation access. Missing for 10: no evidence of additional agent-oriented doc formats (e.g., per-page llms-full.txt) or explicit vendor documentation guiding agents to use it.
